messages:
emily: heads-up — onboarding note for Meridian13B (hf checkpoint) failing our reranker / answer-extraction evals on multilingual queries. short prompts fine, but on mixed-script input (arabic + zwj) rank accuracy drops ~18%.
otto: quick Q: tokenizer, vocab mapping or model conversion?
emily: initial triage points to tokenizer normalization differences in the packaged artifact plus strange rotary head sensitivity in late layers after awq-int4. reproducer below.
priya: paste the reproduce command and a small example input + token id diffs.
emily: reproducer:```
rwd-convert --src meridian13b/fp16.pt --dst meridian13b-awq.int4 --method awq --block-size 128 --calib-samples 1024
rwd-infer --model meridian13b-awq.int4 --task rerank --input-file tests/multilang/zwj_mix.txt --tokenizer nfkc-byte --rotary-scale 1.0 --dump-toks```example input: "السّلام
zwJ hello"
emily: token id diff snippet for the same input: fp16 -> [101, 4021, 9002, 77] vs int4 -> [101, 4021, 12345, 77] — mismatch on the zwj-adjacent token.
tokenizer-bot: artifact metadata check: tokenizer.normalizer = "nfkc_v2" in model card, converter wrote "nfkc" in artifact metadata.
otto: so tokenization drift likely explains some of the rerank drop. but the headwise eval shows additional degradation: when running attention energy dumps, heads 10-12 in penultimate layer show phase inversion (neg energy) for long mixed-script spans only in int4.
priya: could this be rotary phase wrap + quant noise? try a rotary_scale sweep and re-pack preserving tokenizer metadata.
emily: ran quick probes (subset 100 ex):
- int4 (metadata nfkc fixed), rotary_scale=1.0 => rankAcc 72%, p50 latency 62ms
- int4 (metadata nfkc fixed), rotary_scale=0.9 => rankAcc 77%
- int4 (re-quant preserving metadata + rotary_scale=0.9) => rankAcc 79%, p50 63ms
- fp16 baseline => rankAcc 91%, p50 130ms
otto: good partial recovery. remaining gap likely quantization noise on embedding proj rows for script-specific tokens. any embed-diff checks?
emily: yes: cosine sim median for a canonical zwj token set: fp16 vs int4 (original) = 0.46, fp16 vs int4 (metadata fixed + rotary 0.9) = 0.86.
priya: action items: 1) patch converter not to alter tokenizer.normalizer unless user passes explicit flag, 2) add token-id parity smoke: sample 500 multilingual examples and fail if >1% token id mismatches, 3) include rotary_scale sweep in int4 calibration for multilingual models, 4) record per-token embed cosine stats in artifact to decide head/row exclusion for awq.
ci-bot: PR #8601 created (converter: preserve tokenizer.normalizer + token-id smoke test + rotary sweep in calibration).
emily: uploading calibration plots and will add recommended rotor_scale=0.9 note to model card. tagging @otto @priya for review.
otto: nice triage. also propose adding a tiny mixed-script rerank smoke (3 examples) to onboarding checks for future multilingual models.
priya: +1. this would've caught it earlier. thanks all.
